complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all combinations of bit and operator flips leads to exponential branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stack-based single-pass parsing computes optimal inversion cost in linear time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate tracks (value, cost_to_flip) pairs and handles equal precedence of and / or operators correctly.

hints.title: Bottom-Up State Tracking
hints.text: Represent each subexpression outcome as a pair containing its boolean value and the minimal cost needed to invert that boolean result.

hints.title: Operator Inversion Cost Transitions
hints.text: For an operation between two subexpressions, determine whether flipping the operator alone or inverting one or both operand values yields a flipped result at lower cost.

hints.title: Parentheses Evaluation Flow
hints.text: Reduce expressions sequentially as terms finish, collapsing closed parenthesized blocks immediately into their evaluated value-cost pairs.
